title: 第二十五章 招人眼球第 二十六章 回山
content_zh:
原本宋风还只是挽了挽袖子没什么动作呢，如今看到突然凑过来的这一只大金毛，脸上却也是露出来了一丝的意外。
来到宋风的跟前，那布莱克则是好奇的看向了宋风面前的大锅，以及里面噼里啪啦响着的热油:
“老先生，请问您的面前烧这么一大锅的热油是想要做什么？难道是要炸肉丸子吗？”
说到最后的时候，布莱克这一个大金毛则是吞咽了一下口水，看起来肉丸子对他好像留下了很深刻的印象。
看着面前这一个壮硕的大金毛，宋风的脸上则是露出了一丝的饶有兴致，随后笑着开口问道:
“看样子你对肉丸子了解的很深？”
而一听到宋风说肉丸子，布莱克这一个大金毛表情则是兴奋了起来，甚至指了指面前的这一个大锅，开口道:
“肉丸子特别好吃，若是老先生你做的话我可以花钱买，我是代表家族来投资的手里有很多的钱。”
看着面前这一个身材壮硕，身上隐隐约约有着锻炼痕迹，看起来有些搞笑的大金毛，宋风则是摇了摇头:
“贫道是在这里表演节目的。”
说到这里的时候，他则是将旁边桌子上的那几个钢蹦都拿了起来，随即丢入了已经咕噜咕噜冒泡的热油里面:
“贫道要把手伸入油锅里面，把这几个钢蹦取出来，这是古老的戏法，用来表演博一些彩头。”
看到宋风的动作听着宋风的话，这大金毛的脸上则是露出了一丝由衷的怀疑之色，甚至双眼之中都带着一丝茫然，好像是听不懂有些待机了一样:
“老先生，我的语言学的还不是那么的好，兴许是听错了，您的意思是说要用手把这锅里的东西捞出来吗？”
说到这里的时候，布莱克的双眼之中也带着一丝丝迷茫，尤其是看着那热锅，这是属于人类基因之中本能的恐惧:
“真的可以把手伸进去，把钱捞出来吗？这种残忍的刑罚怎么可能出现在这样的时代？”
听到了布莱克如此说，一起凑过来旁观的几个其他年轻人则是开口为他解释说，这是一个用来玩耍的戏法，也就是假的，并不是真的把手放到里面烫坏。
也就是说，这并不是什么刑罚。
而听到了周围这些人的解释之后，布莱克的双眼之中满是好奇之色，甚至凑过来对着宋风开口道:
“老先生，您捞的时候能不能让我看看？我也想看一看这种古老的彩戏法，对，应当是这么叫的，就叫彩戏法。”

听到了面前这黄毛如此说，宋风则是点了点头，随即把两只手的袖子挽好之后放在油锅上。
“贫道这油锅取匙就是为了表演节目，所有人都能看，没有什么秘密。”
说到这里的时候，看着周围已经凑过来了一圈，宋风则是在众人的眼中把一只手伸了进去，甚至还在油锅里面轻轻晃了晃，这才将里面的一枚钢蹦取了出来，丢在了旁边的桌子上:
“各位可以来瞧一瞧，看看这钢蹦是不是在锅里面烫过，是不是真的被贫道从锅里面捞了出来？”
原本过来看热闹的几个人，就因为布莱克这一个大黄毛在这里感觉到非常有趣，现如今看到这一幕更是惊讶。
其中以布莱克为甚:“哇！真的捞出来了，这就是功夫嘛？”
说到这里的时候，那布莱克甚至于还凑到了桌子前伸手轻轻摸了摸那钢蹦，那钢蹦太烫还把他的手烫了一下，让他在原地跳了起来:
“……好烫！好烫！”
众人看着布莱克这般样子也是纷纷笑了起来，看着这个大黄毛在这里蹦蹦跳跳的，这可比看戏法有趣的多。
布莱克见到了宋风直接在油锅里把东西捞出来之后更是惊讶，随即也是一直跟着宋风生怕落了什么关键地方。
content_en:
Originally, Song Feng just rolled up his sleeves and did nothing, but now when he saw the big golden retriever that suddenly came over, there was a trace of surprise on his face.
Arriving in front of Song Feng, Blake looked curiously at the big pot in front of Song Feng and the crackling hot oil inside:
"Old sir, what do you want to do with such a large pot of hot oil in front of you? Are you trying to fry meatballs?"
At the end of the sentence, Blake, the big golden retriever, swallowed his saliva, and it seemed that Meatballs seemed to have left a deep impression on him.
Looking at the sturdy golden retriever in front of him, Song Feng's face showed a trace of interest, and then he smiled and asked:
"It seems like you know a lot about meatballs?"
When he heard Song Feng talking about meatballs, Blake's golden retriever expression became excited. He even pointed at the big pot in front of him and said:
"The meatballs are very delicious. If you make them, old man, I can spend money to buy them. I am investing on behalf of my family and I have a lot of money in my hand."
Looking at the tall golden retriever in front of him, with vague traces of exercise and a somewhat funny look, Song Feng shook his head:
"Pindao is here to perform."
When he said this, he picked up the steel springs on the table next to him and immediately threw them into the bubbling hot oil:
"The poor man has to put his hand into the oil pan and take out these steel springs. This is an ancient trick used to win some prizes."
Seeing Song Feng's actions and listening to Song Feng's words, the big golden retriever's face showed a trace of sincere suspicion, and there was even a trace of confusion in his eyes, as if he didn't understand and was on standby:
"Old sir, my language skills are not that good. Maybe I heard it wrong. Do you mean to fish out the contents of the pot with your hands?"
When he said this, Blake's eyes also showed a trace of confusion, especially when he looked at the hot pot. This is the instinctive fear in human genes:
"Is it really possible to put your hand in and fish out the money? How could such a cruel punishment appear in an era like this?"
After hearing what Blake said, several other young people who came together to watch began to explain to him that this was a trick for fun, that is, it was fake, and it did not really mean that he put his hands in it and got burned.
In other words, this is not a punishment.
After hearing the explanations from the people around him, Blake's eyes were filled with curiosity, and he even came over to Song Feng and said:
"Old sir, can you let me have a look while you're fishing? I also want to see this ancient color trick. Yes, that's what it's called. It's called the color trick."
After hearing what Huang Mao said, Song Feng nodded, then rolled up the sleeves of both hands and placed them on the oil pan.
"Pindao takes the spoon out of the frying pan just for a show. Everyone can watch it. There is no secret."
When he said this, looking at the people around him, Song Feng put his hand in and even shook it slightly in the oil pan. Then he took out a steel spring inside and threw it on the table next to him:
"Everyone can come and take a look to see if this steel bungee has been scalded in a pot. Is it really taken out of the pot by Pindao?"
The few people who originally came to watch the excitement found it very interesting because of the big yellow guy Blake, and now they were even more surprised when they saw this scene.
Among them, Black said: "Wow! I really fished it out. Is this Kung Fu?"
When he said this, Blake even came to the table and stretched out his hand to gently touch the steel bungee. The steel bungee was so hot that it burned his hand and kept him there.Jumped up:
"...So hot! So hot!"
Everyone laughed when they saw Blake like this. Watching this big yellow hair jumping around here was much more interesting than watching tricks.
Blake was even more surprised when he saw Song Feng fish out things directly from the oil pan, and then followed Song Feng for fear of missing some key place.
